Kotlin Coroutines: foundations та internalsрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після цього етапу ви маєте вміти пояснити coroutine без метафори «легкий thread», прочитати її context і Job tree, обрати scope/dispatcher/builder, зробити blocking або callback API main-safe та cancellable, а також діагностувати ownership, confinement і cancellation defects. Детальна failure propagation, exception handling і coroutine testing належать Stage 8.

Senior mental model#

Coroutine — не thread, а кероване обчислення з lifecycle та context. Воно виконується на thread лише поки має роботу; може suspend без блокування цього thread, а потім продовжитися inline або бути dispatched. Scope задає ownership, Job — lifetime tree, dispatcher — де runnable continuation може виконуватися. suspend саме по собі не переносить роботу з main.

  • Suspension: функція зберігає logical continuation і повертає control caller-у; underlying thread може виконувати іншу роботу.
  • Blocking: thread не може виконувати іншу роботу до повернення API; wrapping у coroutine не робить blocking call неблокуючим.
  • Thread switching: окреме рішення dispatcher/API. Suspension може завершитися без switch, а resumption може бути inline або queued.
  • Structured ownership: робота має parent і bounded lifetime; це не гарантія DB transaction, exactly-once network effect чи business atomicity.

Internals: Continuation, state machine і context#

Suspend transformation mental model#

Корисна модель: compiler перетворює suspend-функцію на continuation-passing форму з додатковим Continuation<T>; generated state зберігає program counter і лише потрібні locals навколо можливих suspension points. Виклик або повертає результат одразу, або спеціальний suspended marker, а пізніше continuation отримує result/failure через resumeWith. Це mental model, а не обіцянка конкретної назви generated class, кількості allocations чи bytecode shape: backend/compiler можуть оптимізувати.

// Source
suspend fun profile(id: UserId): Profile {
    val local = cache.read(id)       // may complete inline
    return local ?: api.fetch(id)    // may suspend
}

// Conceptual only, not source/API-compatible generated code:
fun profile(id: UserId, completion: Continuation<Profile>): Any? =
    stateMachine(id, completion)

Continuation.context carries CoroutineContext. Context is an indexed set of elements such as Job, dispatcher, CoroutineName, and thread-context elements. left + right combines it; an element on the right replaces an element with the same key. It is not an ordered interceptor pipeline.

Scope, Job tree, launch/async і boundaries#

  • CoroutineScope is an owner plus coroutineContext, not just a launch utility. A custom long-lived scope needs an explicit owner, Job, dispatcher, shutdown point, and observability.
  • A child Job belongs to its parent; parent completion waits for children and parent cancellation propagates downward. Exact failure/supervision rules are Stage 8.
  • launch returns Job: use for concurrent work whose value is not returned. async returns Deferred<T>: use when a concurrent result will be awaited. async { x() }.await() immediately adds overhead without concurrency.
  • coroutineScope creates a structured boundary and returns after its children finish. supervisorScope creates a supervisory boundary so sibling ownership differs; reserve detailed failure behavior and handler rules for Stage 8.

Dispatchers, withContext і confinement#

ToolUseBoundary / caveat
Dispatchers.MainAndroid UI access and short UI state work.Requires the platform Main dispatcher; no blocking I/O or long CPU loop.
Main.immediateAvoid an extra dispatch when already on the matching main context.Can resume inline and change reentrancy/order assumptions; otherwise dispatches. Not supported identically on every platform.
DefaultCPU-bound work with bounded shared parallelism.Parallel work is not automatically faster; chunking, cancellation checks, contention and measurement matter.
IOBlocking I/O that cannot be made suspending.Shared elastic resources; not “one new thread per coroutine” and not a licence for unbounded downstream load.
limitedParallelism(n)A dispatcher view limiting concurrent execution for a subsystem.Not a dedicated thread, queue durability, fairness SLA, or external resource pool. Use n=1 for sequential execution, not thread identity.

withContext(context) merges the supplied context, runs the block, and returns its result while preserving structured ownership. A changed dispatcher normally dispatches to it and back, but no universal thread switch is guaranteed: equivalent/immediate contexts may execute inline. Inject dispatchers at boundaries so blocking/CPU implementation details are main-safe and testable.

Cooperative cancellation і cleanup#

Cancellation is cooperative. Cancellable suspending functions check it; a CPU loop or blocking API that never suspends must poll ensureActive(), use yield() where fair yielding is actually desired, or call an interruptible/cancellable adapter. yield() is not a scheduler fairness guarantee or performance fix.

suspend fun index(rows: List<Row>): Index = withContext(cpuDispatcher) {
    buildIndex {
        rows.forEachIndexed { i, row ->
            if (i % 256 == 0) ensureActive()
            add(row)
        }
    }
}

try {
    sync()
} finally {
    withContext(NonCancellable) { closeSession() } // short suspending cleanup only
}

finally виконує звичайний non-suspending cleanup. NonCancellable потрібен лише для bounded suspending cleanup, який мусить завершитися після cancellation; він не створює незалежну background lifetime. Timeout, retry і compensating business effects тут не підміняються.

Android ownership: ViewModel, Lifecycle і collection#

  • viewModelScope owns screen/business work that should survive configuration changes and is cancelled when ViewModel is cleared. The repository exposes main-safe suspend APIs; it should not smuggle UI lifetime into GlobalScope.
  • lifecycleScope is cancelled when its Lifecycle is destroyed. For Fragment View UI, use viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope, not the Fragment lifetime for stale bindings.
  • repeatOnLifecycle(STARTED) suspends its caller, launches the block while at least STARTED, cancels that block below STARTED, and restarts it on re-entry. Launch independent collectors as children inside the block; sequential collect calls do not run concurrently.
  • A true application scope can be injected for app-lifetime work, but must have documented owner/shutdown/error policy. Avoid GlobalScope and per-call CoroutineScope(...) because they hide cancellation and leak work beyond the caller.

Callback bridging, runBlocking і context propagation#

suspend fun LocationClient.awaitFix(): Fix = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
    val callback = object : Callback {
        override fun onFix(value: Fix) {
            stop(this)
            if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(value) // API must have one terminal path
        }
        override fun onError(t: Throwable) {
            stop(this)
            if (cont.isActive) cont.resumeWithException(t)
        }
    }
    cont.invokeOnCancellation { stop(callback) }
    start(callback)
}

Adapter має atomic/single terminal protocol: callback resumes continuation at most once, cancellation unregisters callback and releases resources, synchronous callback during registration is safe, and late callback is ignored or disposed. suspendCancellableCoroutine має prompt cancellation guarantee: якщо Job скасовано до dispatched resumption, coroutine не продовжить успішно, тому transferred resource потребує cancellation disposer. isActive alone is not atomic protection against two racing callbacks; prefer upstream unregister/atomic guard and the overloads that define resource cleanup.

runBlocking bridges blocking callers by blocking the current thread while running an event loop. Use at process entry points, narrow legacy/test boundaries—not inside suspend code, Android main callbacks, repositories, or servers where it can starve/deadlock constrained executors.

A coroutine may resume on another thread; raw ThreadLocal values do not automatically follow it. Prefer explicit context parameters. Where legacy libraries require it, use ThreadLocal.asContextElement(value) and understand it propagates a context value, not arbitrary in-coroutine mutations; MDC and copyable context behavior are library/version-specific.

Guarantees vs non-guarantees#

Можна стверджуватиНе можна обіцяти
Suspension може звільнити thread для іншої роботи; coroutine має context і Job.Coroutine є thread, або кожна suspension змінює thread.
suspend дозволяє suspension points.suspend автоматично робить blocking API неблокуючим або переносить роботу з main.
Structured scope чекає owned children і поширює cancellation за Job tree.Business operation стала atomic, durable або exactly once.
Cancellation signal і cancellable suspension підтримують cooperative stop.Arbitrary CPU/native/blocking code припиниться негайно.
Dispatcher визначає execution policy для continuations.Конкретний thread, queue fairness, порядок усіх resumptions або inline/dispatch у кожному випадку.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • Pin Kotlin, kotlinx-coroutines-core, kotlinx-coroutines-android і AndroidX Lifecycle versions; перевіряйте API docs саме для resolved version.
  • Dispatchers.Main на Android надає integration module; Main.immediate semantics та support залежать від platform dispatcher.
  • limitedParallelism, debugging APIs, test scheduler і thread-context facilities еволюціонують. Не переносіть snippets між major/minor versions без migration notes.
  • DebugProbes та debug-agent capabilities можуть бути experimental/version-sensitive й мати overhead; production enablement потребує окремого рішення.

Decision framework#

  1. Визначте owner/lifetime: caller, ViewModel, view Lifecycle, application чи durable scheduler?
  2. Класифікуйте роботу: suspending I/O, blocking I/O, CPU, UI mutation чи callback bridge.
  3. Оберіть API: sequential suspend by default; launch for owned no-result work; async only for a concurrent value.
  4. Поставте boundary: main-safe implementation with injected dispatcher; concurrency limit tied to the real bottleneck.
  5. Спроєктуйте cancellation/cleanup: suspension checks, loop polling, unregister/close, bounded NonCancellable.
  6. Перевірте semantics: ownership tree, resumption/reentrancy, thread-local assumptions, logs/traces, process death and business idempotency outside coroutine guarantees.

Trade-offs і failure modes#

  • Extra async/dispatcher hops can increase allocations, queues and latency; sequential code is often clearer and faster.
  • IO prevents main blocking but unbounded requests can still exhaust sockets, DB connections or vendor quotas; limit by downstream capacity.
  • Main.immediate removes a hop but inline reentrancy can violate “callback happens later” assumptions.
  • limitedParallelism(1) serializes tasks on a dispatcher view but does not provide a durable queue, process safety, thread affinity or database transaction.
  • Broad NonCancellable hides shutdown and hangs teardown; missing callback unregister leaks owners and permits late double resume.
  • Coroutines reduce waiting cost, not CPU complexity, memory retention, lock contention or network latency. Measure traces and queueing before claiming performance.

Production scenario: checkout orchestration#

Гіпотетично: CheckoutViewModel owns a viewModelScope.launch. Repository API is main-safe: remote suspending calls remain sequential until genuine parallelism is required; legacy receipt parsing uses injected Default.limitedParallelism(2), and a blocking SDK call is isolated on injected IO capacity. Two independent quotes use sibling async values inside coroutineScope and are both awaited.

Lifecycle UI collects state through viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope + repeatOnLifecycle. A payment SDK callback is wrapped with suspendCancellableCoroutine, one atomic terminal decision, unregister-on-cancel, and late-token disposal. Cancellation stops UI ownership but does not claim the remote charge was rolled back: payment uses an idempotency key, durable operation record, server status query and reconciliation. That transaction protocol is outside structured-concurrency guarantees.

Code-review/debugging trap#

fun refresh() {
    CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch { // hidden owner; never cancelled
        val dto = api.load()                // suspend does not prove blocking safety
        withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { render(dto) }
    }
}

suspend fun awaitSdk() = suspendCancellableCoroutine<Result> { c ->
    sdk.start { c.resume(it) }              // no unregister; callback may fire twice
}

Review questions: хто owns Job і де shutdown; чи api.load справді main-safe; навіщо ручний Main hop замість state owner; чи inline Main.immediate створює reentrancy; що робить cancellation; чи callback має single terminal protocol. Debug з CoroutineName, IDE Coroutines view, -Dkotlinx.coroutines.debug у non-production diagnostic run, job-tree/log correlation та traces навколо blocking call. Debug probes допомагають побачити suspended stacks, але не доводять business ownership або exactly-once.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. Coroutine — це lightweight thread? Ні. Це computation з continuation, context і Job, яке виконується на threads за dispatcher policy; багато coroutines можуть ділити threads.
  2. Що реально означає suspend? Функція може suspend і пізніше resume continuation; modifier не гарантує background thread, non-blocking implementation чи thread switch.
  3. Як уявляти compiler transformation? Як continuation-passing state machine з label і live locals біля suspension points, без обіцянки exact generated classes/allocations.
  4. Як складається CoroutineContext? Це keyed elements; left + right replaces an element with the same key. Job defines lifetime, dispatcher execution policy.
  5. launch чи async? launch for owned no-result work; async when a concurrently produced value is awaited. Immediate await usually means sequential suspend was better.
  6. coroutineScope чи supervisorScope? Both bound children and await completion; supervisor boundary changes sibling failure ownership. Detailed failure propagation belongs to Stage 8.
  7. Default, IO чи Main? Main for short UI access, Default for CPU work, IO for unavoidable blocking I/O; inject them and limit according to downstream capacity.
  8. Як працює cancellation? Cooperatively: cancellable suspension observes it; CPU loops call ensureActive/yield deliberately; cleanup uses finally and narrowly bounded NonCancellable when it must suspend.
  9. Як правильно bridge callback? suspendCancellableCoroutine, at-most-one terminal resume, unregister on cancellation, safe synchronous registration, and late resource cleanup.
  10. Що structured concurrency не гарантує? Воно bounds lifetime and joins children, але не дає transaction atomicity, durability, remote rollback чи exactly-once effects.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. withContext(IO) викликано з IO. Не обіцяйте switch: implementation may continue without a meaningful hop. Correctness comes from execution policy, not a thread-name assertion.
  2. Потрібен single-threaded mutable engine. limitedParallelism(1) gives sequential execution but not one stable thread; if the library requires thread identity, use/document an appropriate owned dispatcher/executor and close it.
  3. Callback повернув resource одночасно з cancellation. Design an atomic terminal hand-off and cancellation disposer; isActive check alone has a race.
  4. User leaves during payment. Cancel UI ownership, but reconcile remote status using durable operation ID/idempotency key; coroutine cancellation is not payment rollback.

5 self-check без відповідей#

  1. Намалюйте Job tree свого screen flow: хто owner і де кожна child завершується?
  2. Які suspend APIs у вашому codebase можуть усе ще блокувати main?
  3. Де Main.immediate або synchronous callback можуть створити reentrancy?
  4. Як ваш callback bridge доводить at-most-once resume та cleanup після cancellation?
  5. Який business effect потребує idempotency/transaction поза structured concurrency?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do Kotlin coroutines work, and how do you choose their ownership and execution context?

~30-second answer#

A coroutine is not a thread. It is an owned computation represented through continuations and a context containing elements such as a Job and dispatcher. Suspension releases control but does not automatically move work off main; resumption may be inline or dispatched. I choose the owner first, keep APIs main-safe, use Main for UI, Default for CPU work and IO for unavoidable blocking calls, and make cancellation and callback cleanup cooperative. Structured concurrency bounds child lifetimes, but it does not make business effects atomic or exactly once.

~2-minute answer#

My mental model starts with the compiler converting a suspend function into continuation-passing code, typically a state machine around suspension points. That is a useful model, not a bytecode-shape guarantee. A coroutine runs on a thread only while executing; suspension is different from blocking, and suspend does not imply an IO dispatcher or any thread switch.

I choose ownership before concurrency. A scope carries a context, its Job forms a parent-child tree, and a structured boundary waits for owned children. I use launch for no-result owned work and async only when I need a concurrently produced value. CoroutineScope and supervisorScope both define boundaries; detailed failure propagation is a separate policy discussion.

Dispatchers are execution policies: Main for short UI work, Default for CPU work, IO for unavoidable blocking I/O. Main.immediate may run inline and limitedParallelism is a view limiting concurrency, not a dedicated thread or durable queue. withContext merges context and returns a result; it does not universally guarantee a switch.

Cancellation is cooperative, so CPU loops check ensureActive and callback adapters unregister on cancellation with a single terminal resume protocol. Android work is owned by viewModelScope or the appropriate Lifecycle, and repeatOnLifecycle restarts collection with visibility. I avoid GlobalScope and ad-hoc scopes. Finally, I separate coroutine guarantees from business guarantees: remote writes still need idempotency, persistence, and reconciliation, and I use coroutine names, IDE tooling and traces to debug ownership and blocking.

Kotlin Coroutines: failures, supervision, cleanup, testing та debuggingрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після цього етапу ви маєте вміти передбачити, де coroutine failure буде rethrow, де скасує siblings, а де стане uncaught; обрати звичайний або supervisory boundary; зберегти cancellation під час cleanup; спроєктувати timeout і callback cleanup; та написати deterministic Android tests без перебільшення гарантій virtual time.

Senior mental model#

Failure policy є частиною ownership tree. Спочатку намалюйте Job tree, позначте root/child, builder і observation point; потім вирішіть, чи один failure має скасувати весь unit of work, чи siblings можуть завершитися незалежно. Exception handling не замінює ownership, а supervision не замінює reporting.

  • launch повідомляє uncaught root failure; async зберігає outcome у Deferred, який спостерігають через await.
  • Звичайна child failure (крім cancellation) скасовує parent і його інших children; parent cancellation іде вниз із cancellation cause.
  • CancellationException — control signal. Broad catch, runCatching або mapping, що його ковтає, може зробити cancelled coroutine логічно живою.
  • Ключове обмеження: supervisor ізолює propagation failure дитини, але не report-ить і не handle-ить її автоматично.

Internals / failure tree#

screen Job (viewModelScope / SupervisorJob)
├─ launch refresh       -- launch failure needs an explicit policy
│  ├─ async profile     -- ordinary child failure cancels refresh
│  └─ async offers      -- sibling is cancelled
└─ launch analytics     -- supervisor isolates it from refresh

coroutineScope: child failure → scope fails → siblings cancel → caller gets failure
supervisorScope: child failure ↛ supervisor/siblings; each child outcome still must be observed

Job переходить до cancelling/completing і чекає children. Перша non-cancellation exception зазвичай стає primary cause, пізніші можуть бути suppressed на підтримуваних platforms; точний порядок racing failures не є business contract. cancel(CancellationException(...)) означає normal cancellation для parent, тоді як non-cancellation child failure propagates upward. Root означає coroutine без parent Job, а не «будь-який launch у ViewModel».

Builders, root/child та await timing#

CaseFailure pathДе handle
Root launchFailure uncaught after children/cleanup finish.CoroutineExceptionHandler for last-resort logging/reporting; or catch inside body when recovery is possible.
Root asyncFailure stored in Deferred; handler does not consume it.await() rethrows; owner must await/inspect.
Child launchDelegates failure to parent; ordinary parent cancels siblings.Catch around failing operation or at structured scope call site—not a child-local handler.
Child asyncIts Job fails immediately and ordinary parent is cancelled even before await.await determines when caller observes the deferred exception; it does not postpone structural propagation.

try/catch must surround the suspending call or await() that rethrows. A try around launch { ... } only surrounds coroutine creation and will not catch a later asynchronous failure. CoroutineExceptionHandler sees uncaught exceptions only at applicable root-like boundaries after failure; coroutine already completed, so it is not a general try/catch and cannot recover that coroutine.

supervisorScope, SupervisorJob та ownership traps#

  • supervisorScope створює lexical SupervisorJob, чекає всіх children і скасовує їх, якщо його block/caller fails або scope cancelled. Failure одного child не скасовує siblings.
  • SupervisorJob(parent) дає довгоживучому owner-у незалежні children; parent cancellation усе ще скасовує supervisor і всіх children.
  • Кожен supervised launch потребує own catch або applicable CoroutineExceptionHandler; кожен async — await/inspection. Ізоляція без observation втрачає failures.
  • Ownership trap: withContext(SupervisorJob()) підміняє caller Job і може від’єднати cancellation. Не вставляйте standalone Job у child context; створюйте named owned scope або lexical supervisorScope.
  • Не supervisor-те steps, якщо результат має бути all-or-nothing. Якщо profile і entitlement утворюють один invariant, sibling cancellation є бажаною fail-fast поведінкою.

Cancellation preservation та cleanup#

suspend fun refresh(): Data = try {
    api.load()
} catch (ce: CancellationException) {
    throw ce
} catch (t: IOException) {
    cache.fallback(t)
}

suspend fun consume(session: Session) {
    try {
        session.read()
    } finally {
        session.close() // non-suspending cleanup; prefer use when AutoCloseable
        withContext(NonCancellable) {
            withTimeout(1_000) { audit.closeSession() } // narrow and bounded
        }
    }
}

Cancellation is cooperative: cancellable suspensions check it, але blocking/native call або CPU loop без checks не зупиняться магічно. Catch only exceptions you can classify. Якщо потрібен broad catch (Throwable), rethrow CancellationException before mapping/logging. Kotlin runCatching catches Throwable; тому без explicit rethrow cancellation може бути перетворена на ordinary failure. finally і use мають бути idempotent де possible. NonCancellable використовуйте вузько лише для suspending cleanup: він відкладає cancellation, але не робить external effect atomic, retryable чи exactly once.

Timeouts, callbackFlow/channelFlow та awaitClose#

  • withTimeout cancels its child і throws TimeoutCancellationException; withTimeoutOrNull returns null on its own timeout. Не змішуйте timeout-null з legitimate null domain value.
  • Timeout is asynchronous relative to block completion: cancellation може race після external side effect, але до delivery результату caller-у. Ресурс створюйте з try/finally або поверненням через documented cleanup hand-off; remote writes потребують idempotency key/status reconciliation.
  • callbackFlow bridges a multi-shot callback. awaitClose { unregister() } keeps it active and performs cleanup on close/cancel; register/unregister мають бути thread-safe, бо cancellation can race registration/callback.
  • channelFlow дозволяє concurrent child sends і завершується після block та children; якщо producer має жити до external close/cancel, останнім boundary лишається awaitClose.

Narrow Flow exception boundaries#

catch є transparent до downstream exceptions і ловить лише upstream від його position; cancellation треба rethrow/не map-ити. retry/retryWhen повторюють upstream, не downstream collector failures і не cancellation; predicate має обмежувати transient classes, attempts, backoff і side-effect safety. Не retry-те non-idempotent write без operation key. Flow content навмисно вузький; повна модель Flow належить Stages 9–11.

Guarantees vs non-guarantees#

Можна стверджуватиНе можна обіцяти
Ordinary child failure cancels its parent; coroutineScope cancels siblings.Failure завжди з’явиться лише в await або handler на child його recover-ить.
A supervisor isolates child-failure propagation.Supervisor automatically reports, handles, retries, or makes failure successful.
Cancellation is cooperative; finally executes as stack unwinds.Blocking/I/O/CPU work stops immediately or cleanup can never fail.
Virtual time пропускає сумісні delays, а не реальний blocking/I/O.runTest simulates device scheduling, networks, threads, or all production dispatchers.
awaitClose gives a cleanup hook when channel closes/cancels.External callback API is thread-safe, single-shot, or free from registration races.
Structured cleanup bounds coroutine resources.External side effects are rolled back, idempotent, durable, or exactly once.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • Pin Kotlin і однакову family version для kotlinx-coroutines-core/-test; test APIs changed materially around 1.6, а exact default timeout та experimental annotations перевіряйте у resolved API docs.
  • Dispatchers.setMain global на JVM; якщо Main встановлено TestDispatcher, scheduler може бути reused новими test dispatchers/scopes. Creation order therefore matters.
  • AndroidX Lifecycle/ViewModel test behavior залежить від versions і Main dispatcher integration; local JVM test відрізняється від instrumented test з real main looper.
  • IDE coroutine view, -Dkotlinx.coroutines.debug, DebugProbes та recovered stack traces мають version/platform/optimization limitations і overhead. Перевіряйте docs для toolchain, не робіть їх production contract.

Decision / test framework#

  1. Намалюйте tree: owner, parent, root/child, launch/async, result observer та shutdown.
  2. Визначте invariant: fail-fast unit чи незалежні results? Оберіть coroutineScope або supervision свідомо.
  3. Класифікуйте outcome: cancellation, transient domain failure, programmer bug, fatal/platform error; не перетворюйте все на один Result.
  4. Спроєктуйте cleanup: close/unregister once, race-safe; suspending cleanup — bounded NonCancellable; external writes — idempotency/reconciliation.
  5. Inject controllable boundaries: dispatchers, owner scopes, clock/time source, retry/timeout policy та fakes.
  6. Тестуйте observable contract: state/result, sibling cancellation/continuation, cause preservation, callback unregister, timeout boundaries й uncaught failures—not internal launch count.
  7. Зробіть race pass окремо: real dispatchers/integration/stress tests; runTest не робить production races неможливими.

Deterministic tests with kotlinx-coroutines-test#

@Test fun refresh_retries_then_succeeds() = runTest {
    val dispatcher = StandardTestDispatcher(testScheduler)
    val repo = OrdersRepository(api, dispatcher, clock = TestClock(testScheduler))

    val result = backgroundScope.async { repo.refresh() }
    advanceTimeBy(1_000)
    runCurrent()                 // run tasks scheduled exactly at the new time
    advanceUntilIdle()           // drain finite foreground work
    assertEquals(Orders.Ready, result.await())
}
  • runTest provides a TestScope, skips compatible delays through a TestCoroutineScheduler, waits for structured children, and reports uncaught child failures at test completion. Do not hide expected failures in forgotten children.
  • StandardTestDispatcher queues work until the scheduler runs it—good for explicit ordering. UnconfinedTestDispatcher eagerly enters top-level launches and is convenient for simple tests, but resumption ordering is not a production guarantee.
  • All injected TestDispatchers in one test must share the same TestCoroutineScheduler. Multiple schedulers create split virtual clocks and misleading drains.
  • advanceTimeBy(n) moves virtual time; call runCurrent() for work at the boundary. advanceUntilIdle() drains scheduled work but intentionally does not wait forever for backgroundScope; that scope is cancelled when test ends.
  • Dispatchers.setMain(testDispatcher) belongs in setup and Dispatchers.resetMain() in guaranteed teardown. Create dependent dispatchers after Main replacement or pass testScheduler explicitly.

Android ViewModel/repository tests#

Для local ViewModel test replace Main через reusable rule, construct ViewModel після rule setup, trigger intent, run scheduler, assert public UI state і failure/cancellation transitions. Repository test injects dispatcher, scope only when repository truly owns longer work, clock/time policy and fake data sources; verify main-safety, cleanup and result—not private coroutine structure. Instrumented/UI tests keep real Main and cover lifecycle/Looper integration separately. Для Flow assertions можна використати manual collector у backgroundScope. Turbine — popular third-party helper from Cash App, not Kotlin/AndroidX official guarantee; pin its version і не приписуйте йому production ordering semantics.

Debugging failures and lost cancellation#

  1. Дайте boundary CoroutineName("checkout-refresh") і correlation/operation ID; log owner, Job state, cancellation/failure class and cause without sensitive payload.
  2. У IntelliJ IDEA/Android Studio debugger inspect Coroutines view: RUNNING/SUSPENDED, creation/suspension stack і dispatcher. Це snapshot, not complete history.
  3. Для diagnostic run використайте -Dkotlinx.coroutines.debug або, якщо supported, DebugProbes; врахуйте overhead, experimental/version limits та вимкніть у production unless deliberately approved.
  4. Stacktrace recovery/probes не відтворюють кожен optimized/inlined/native frame і не доводять race order. Додайте scheduler timestamps, structured logs, traces і minimal deterministic reproduction.

Trade-offs і failure modes#

  • Fail-fast ordinary scope preserves a unit invariant but discards useful independent partial results; supervision preserves siblings but increases per-child observation/reporting work.
  • Broad catch simplifies a signature but hides cancellation/programmer defects; ultra-narrow catches leak transport types. Translate only at a documented layer and preserve causes.
  • Timeout improves latency bounds but adds an ambiguous completion race around external effects. Treat it as caller patience, not remote rollback.
  • Large NonCancellable cleanup delays shutdown; too-small cleanup may leak. Make close idempotent, bounded and observable.
  • Virtual-time tests are fast and deterministic but can miss thread confinement, blocking and races; supplement them rather than claiming scheduler equivalence.
  • Cleanup/idempotency and external side effects need separate design: Job completion alone cannot prove either.

Production scenario: supervised home refresh#

Гіпотетично: Home ViewModel starts one owned refresh. Account + entitlement form a required unit inside coroutineScope: either child failure cancels its sibling and maps at the use-case boundary. Recommendations and badges are optional inside supervisorScope; every async is awaited into an explicit section result, while a fire-and-forget diagnostic launch has a handler/reporting policy. User cancellation is rethrown, not shown as an error.

A location stream uses callbackFlow and race-safe awaitClose unregister. Refresh timeout bounds caller waiting but server writes carry an idempotency key and are reconciled after ambiguous timeout. Local tests share one scheduler, replace Main for ViewModel, test sibling cancellation and optional isolation, then integration/stress tests cover real dispatcher and callback races.

Code-review/debugging trap#

suspend fun load() = supervisorScope {
    launch(CoroutineExceptionHandler { _, e -> logger.log(e) }) { requiredWrite() }
    val optional = async { optionalRead() } // never awaited: deferred failure lost
    runCatching { withTimeout(500) { api.commit() } }
        .getOrNull()                        // swallows cancellation; null is ambiguous
}

@Test fun test() = runTest {
    val repo = Repo(Dispatchers.IO)         // real delay/blocking escapes virtual time
    repo.load()
    advanceUntilIdle()
}

Review: required work should not be supervised merely to “keep going”; handler logs but does not recover; async needs observation; runCatching must preserve CancellationException; timeout cannot prove commit absence; production dispatcher/time must be injected; all test dispatchers share scheduler. Debug by naming the refresh, locating the first failed Job/cause, checking whether cancellation was remapped, and correlating server operation ID before retry.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. Як відрізняється failure launch і async? Root launch reports uncaught failure; async stores outcome and await rethrows. As ordinary children, both Jobs fail structurally and can cancel parent before await.
  2. Чому try { launch {} } не ловить failure? Try wraps only immediate builder call; asynchronous body fails later. Catch inside body or around structured suspend/await boundary.
  3. Для чого CoroutineExceptionHandler? Last-resort handling of applicable uncaught root-like failures, mainly logging/reporting. It cannot recover a completed coroutine and does not consume async outcome.
  4. coroutineScope чи supervisorScope? Use ordinary scope for one fail-fast invariant; supervisor for independently meaningful children, each with explicit observation and error policy.
  5. Що робить SupervisorJob? Child failure does not fail supervisor or siblings; parent cancellation still goes down. It does not report failures automatically.
  6. Як не проковтнути cancellation? Avoid broad catches; if unavoidable, rethrow CancellationException before mapping. Be cautious with runCatching.
  7. Коли потрібен NonCancellable? Only for short bounded suspending cleanup in finally; ordinary close/use needs none. It does not make business effects safe.
  8. Чим небезпечний timeout? It races completion/delivery and may follow an external side effect. Design idempotency and reconciliation; distinguish timeout null from domain null.
  9. Standard чи Unconfined test dispatcher? Standard queues for explicit scheduler control; Unconfined eagerly enters top-level launches but does not guarantee production ordering. Share one scheduler.
  10. Що runTest не доводить? It skips compatible delays and surfaces child failures, but does not model real blocking/I/O, device scheduling or eliminate production races.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Перший async failed до того, як код awaits другий. In ordinary scope its failure cancels parent/sibling immediately; await order changes observation, not structural propagation. In supervisor, explicitly await both and define partial-result semantics.
  2. Supervised launch crashes despite handler on supervisorScope? A supervisor does not install reporting automatically. Put an applicable handler in the launching context/child or catch in child, and test the policy.
  3. Timeout happened after payment endpoint received request. Treat status as unknown, persist operation ID, query/reconcile and retry only with the same idempotency key; coroutine timeout is not rollback.
  4. advanceUntilIdle hangs or misses collector work. Move intentional infinite work to backgroundScope, share scheduler, use runCurrent at exact time boundaries, and assert finite observable events.

5 self-check без відповідей#

  1. Намалюйте failure tree для одного ViewModel intent і позначте кожен observation point.
  2. Які broad catches/runCatching у codebase можуть ковтати CancellationException?
  3. Який cleanup має бути idempotent, race-safe і bounded?
  4. Чи всі TestDispatchers ділять один scheduler, і яка робота escapes virtual time?
  5. Який timeout залишає external side effect у невідомому стані та як його reconcile?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do you design coroutine failure handling, supervision, cleanup, and tests?

~30-second answer#

I start from the Job tree and the invariant. In an ordinary scope, a child failure cancels its parent and siblings; I use supervision only for independently meaningful children, and I still observe every launch or deferred failure. CoroutineExceptionHandler is last-resort reporting, not recovery. I preserve CancellationException, clean up in finally or use, and use bounded NonCancellable only for suspending cleanup. Tests inject dispatchers, scopes, and time, share one TestCoroutineScheduler under runTest, and assert outcomes and cleanup. Virtual time does not simulate blocking I/O or remove production races.

~2-minute answer#

I first draw ownership: root versus child, launch versus async, and where each result is observed. A root launch can produce an uncaught exception; async exposes its outcome through Deferred and await. A normal child failure immediately participates in Job propagation, so await timing does not postpone cancellation of an ordinary parent. CoroutineExceptionHandler is only for applicable uncaught failures after the coroutine has failed; it is not a general catch or recovery mechanism.

I choose coroutineScope for one fail-fast unit and supervisorScope or an owned SupervisorJob only when children are independently useful. Supervision isolates propagation but never reports or handles failures automatically, so launches need catch or reporting and deferred values need await. I preserve CancellationException, avoid broad runCatching mappings, and put resource release in use or finally. NonCancellable is narrow, bounded, and only for suspending cleanup.

Timeout limits waiting, not external side effects. Cancellation can race result delivery, so writes use idempotency keys and reconciliation. callbackFlow and channelFlow use race-safe awaitClose cleanup. Flow catch and retry are positioned only around upstream transient work; broader Flow semantics are separate.

For tests, I inject dispatchers, scopes, clocks, and timeout policies. runTest provides TestScope and virtual time; StandardTestDispatcher gives explicit queued execution, while UnconfinedTestDispatcher eagerly enters top-level launches. Every test dispatcher shares one TestCoroutineScheduler. I use advanceTimeBy plus runCurrent at boundaries, backgroundScope for intentional long-lived work, and setMain/resetMain for local ViewModel tests. Then I add real-dispatcher integration or stress tests because virtual time skips compatible delays, not blocking I/O, and cannot prove production races absent. I debug with CoroutineName, IDE coroutine views, diagnostic debug mode or probes, correlation IDs, and traces while treating recovered stacks as incomplete evidence.
